grain.resolution: Half viewport width and height: quarter pixel count, 2x CSS enlargement; capped at 960x540.
grain.cadence: At most 12fps, quantized by the existing shared frame clock; no catch-up draws, own RAF or interval.
grain.model: Original correlated monochrome random walk, not a physical Kodak or other film-emulsion model.
grain.composite: One soft-light full-screen canvas, no blend stack. Preserves endpoint highlights; not a luminance-selective mask.
grain.lifecycle: Hidden pages and modals pause. Mobile, coarse-pointer and reduced-motion modes generate a still frame at each viewport size. Forced colors hide it.
grain.performanceBoundary: No universal GPU percentage, physical 120Hz panel or acoustic claim is established by these settings.

light.behavior: Existing ambient radial fields stay static, pointer-events:none, with no Gaussian blur. Separate hero/theatre horizontal spill uses transform-only drift from the shared measure/write clock.

atmosphere.tonalRamps: Derived OKLCH swatches for the palette inspector only. These are not additional implementation tokens or approved action colors.

works.behavior: Static localized cyan and vermilion radial fields.

biography.behavior: Static localized cyan and vermilion radial fields over the existing dark tonal field.

inactiveFilm.purpose: Retains the side image's exposure beneath its existing slot opacity without the old parent desaturation or heavy horizontal wash.

spill.motion: Translate up to 10px from clamped scroll progress; rotate progress*.32deg plus viewport-aspect correction clamped to .08deg.
spill.fallback: Static on mobile, coarse pointer and reduced motion; decorative fields hidden under forced colors.

sidePlanes.fallback: Mobile, coarse-pointer and reduced-motion layouts retain the unrotated slot treatment.

dossier.container: Independent .biography-spread 12-column grid within outer .biography.section-space block; mobile spread has one column. Sticky travel is bounded above the following comparison gate.

breakdown.placement: Following sibling of .biography-spread in the outer About block; centered at 72% of body clientWidth, matching the cinema gate without scrollbar-width drift.

interaction.source: src/styles/cinema.css, src/styles/spatial.css, src/lib/cinemaFrames.ts, src/components/about/CineBreakdown.tsx, src/hooks/useFilmScrub.ts, src/hooks/useTransportSpring.ts
interaction.shell: Untransformed sensing controls contain inert visual descendants; moving visual subtrees have pointer-events:none.
interaction.driver: Providers retains exactly one requestAnimationFrame owner, with optional Lenis integration on desktop. Native-scroll mobile and reduced-motion modes retain the same shared cinema clock. All geometry reads precede queued writes; component effects subscribe rather than own a RAF.
interaction.fallbacks: Mobile, coarse pointer and reduced motion remove pointer lift, magnetic transforms, film-strip scanning and reading dimming. Reduced motion removes carousel transitions and immediately places the ruler. The comparison range remains directly operable; decorative grain becomes still.

ending.scope: Final sentence of the director monologue only.
ending.behavior: Wrap its final two words in a nonbreaking span; dictionary text is unchanged.

breakdown.disclosure: Visible COLOR STUDY caption and four-language accessible explanation. Simulated same-frame grading, not original Log, greenscreen or a delivered VFX shot.
breakdown.divider: 1px rgba(255,62,0,.8); inert translate3d track and 44px touch-capture target.
breakdown.control: Desktop pointer follow; touch divider drag with pointer capture. Pointer-up stores the final clientX before release; pointer-cancel retains the last position. Native keyboard range with Home, End and arrow keys; whole-frame focus outline.
breakdown.geometry: Fixed untransformed viewport; scroll/resize-invalidated rect cache read only in shared measure phase, then clipped-image/divider/range writes. No new RAF, blur or autonomous motion.

scopedTypography.accessibility: PASS and LC inscriptions are aria-hidden optical metadata; four-language accessible asset explanation and separately associated operating instruction remain independent. The visible COLOR STUDY descriptor is a short caption, not an operational dependency. Load errors are real status messages.

filmScrub.sampling: Six existing licensed films, four source-time stills each. Twelve catalogue records share the corresponding six source sets.
filmScrub.timecode: Normalized source duration with a 24fps display timebase; source frame rates remain distinct and recorded in the manifest.
filmScrub.interaction: Current desktop film only; warm on pointer movement/focus, select one of four frames from horizontal progress, fade by opacity, restore cover on pointer leave. Keyboard-only range operates the same progress.
filmScrub.fallback: Inactive/archive/mobile/coarse-pointer/reduced-motion retain cover or preview. Failed stills leave cover visible.
filmScrub.performance: Stable trigger geometry, shared read/write phases, dynamically scoped will-change and paused hidden-page subscriptions.

audio.optIn: No AudioContext before explicit sound-button gesture; consent is not persisted; no automatic resume after tab, blur or modal interruption.
audio.hum: 50Hz sine; digital peak amplitude 10 ** (-36 / 20), not a sound-pressure or perceived-loudness guarantee.
audio.click: Original reusable 15ms decaying noise impulse, low-pass 1800Hz, gain .012, 40ms trigger guard.
audio.lifecycle: Hidden, blur and film-dialog states silence and suspend the graph. Disposal stops oscillator, disconnects nodes and closes the context.
audio.provenance: Native Web Audio synthesis, no sampled third-party track. Existing silent video files remain unchanged.

control.placement: One global fixed bottom-right sound toggle; right:var(--gutter), bottom:10px, z-index:20; minimum 112x44px. Hero retains only separate video pause/play.
control.states: Localized aria-label and live status; aria-pressed, aria-busy and unavailable/modal disabled states. Consent and lifecycle remain opt-in.

materialAllowances.scope: Explicit narrow allowances from actual sensory.css and breakdown.css; no invented tonal ramps, action colors or global body-text replacements.

narrative.northStar: A film title, a projection room, an author's working plate.
narrative.overview:
The portfolio is contemporary, cold and cinematic. Obsidian supports illuminated moving images; monolithic sans type establishes the studio, while restrained serif text gives the director's voice a separate register. Fine optical readouts and frame geometry provide scale without competing with the films.

The material character comes from a projection gate and a medium-format negative holder. The reserved portrait is an intentional typographic plate until a real portrait is supplied. Surfaces stay open and square, with changes in light and content density carrying the transition from viewing to reading.
keyCharacteristics: Cold obsidian and platinum, with titanium for secondary information.
A rare laser accent used for active markers and the projection ruler.
Monolithic title typography beside small technical readouts.
Square image gates, fine edges and a medium-format dossier.
Static ambient light, a stepped living-grain canvas and restrained motion inside stable controls.
Four-language typography with a distinct Japanese reading stack.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep the laser accent attached to an active state, recording cue or transport position; use platinum for ordinary links and focus.

rules.name: The Language Fidelity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the language-specific font stack and line-breaking rules when adding text; never route Japanese reading text through Chinese fallback fonts.

rules.name: The Fixed Shell Rule
rules.body: Pointer sensing stays on an untransformed control shell. Transform the inert visual descendants, not the hit target. Share the existing frame driver rather than adding another animation loop.

dos: **Do** preserve the cold palette and use laser for the existing signal roles.
**Do** keep the hero name heavy, tightly tracked and clearly separate from the reel entry.
**Do** preserve the theatre's central image gate and its distinct mobile ratio.
**Do** place movement inside stable sensing shells and use the existing shared frame driver.
**Do** keep one stepped grain canvas within the documented opacity and resolution budget, retaining static ambient radials.
**Do** preserve four-language text, Japanese strict line breaking and Korean word grouping.
**Do** retain visible focus, touch and keyboard film navigation, reduced motion and dialog focus return.
**Do** keep the portrait and signature reservation honest until the corresponding real assets exist.
donts: **Don't** introduce brown ageing effects, sepia paper, VHS-store decoration or plastic card surfaces.
**Don't** turn the laser accent into a large background or a generic button fill.
**Don't** add Gaussian blur, full-screen filter animation or stacked blend-mode light layers; the single low-opacity soft-light grain surface is the documented exception.
**Don't** animate the pointer sensing shell or make moving visual descendants interactive.
**Don't** replace the language buttons with a native select or give Japanese text Chinese font fallbacks.
**Don't** fabricate a portrait, signature, client endorsement, festival achievement or hardware-performance claim.
